Package org.jwcarman.who.apikey

package org.jwcarman.who.apikey
  • Class
    Description
    ApiKey
    An identity's key as ApiKeyService.findByIdentity(UUID) lists it, with no secret in it.
    ApiKeyAuthenticationConverter
    Reads an API key from a request header into an ApiKeyAuthenticationToken.
    ApiKeyAuthenticationFilter
    Signs in requests that carry an API key header, through Spring Security's AuthenticationFilter: ApiKeyAuthenticationConverter reads the header and ApiKeyAuthenticationProvider resolves the key.
    ApiKeyAuthenticationProvider
    Signs in with an API key: checks the key's shape, looks it up by its hash, refuses it once expired, and resolves it to an active identity whose permissions are cut down to the key's scopes.
    ApiKeyAuthenticationToken
    An unauthenticated request to sign in with an API key, holding the raw key read from the request header.
    ApiKeyCannotManageKeysException
    A request an API key signed in, to an API-key endpoint other than /current: a key never lists, makes, rotates or revokes keys, so a leaked key cannot make itself permanent. who answers it 403 with the code api-key-cannot-manage-keys; a browser session or a bearer token may manage keys.
    ApiKeyCredential
    Credential representing an API key, stored as a SHA-256 hash.
    ApiKeyCredentialRepository
    Repository for persisting and retrieving ApiKeyCredential records.
    ApiKeyFormat
    The shape of a who API key: a prefix, 30 random base62 characters and a 6-character base62 checksum, the shape GitHub uses for its tokens.
    ApiKeyLoginMethod
    API-key sign-in as a StatelessLoginMethod: adds the ApiKeyAuthenticationFilter as WhoApiKeySecurity.apiKey(ApiKeyAuthenticationFilter) does, and matches the requests the key would sign in: the header is present and not blank, and the request is not already signed in.
    ApiKeyNotFoundException
    A request named an API key that is not one of the caller's own, or asked for the key in use by a request that no API key signed in.
    ApiKeysController
    The caller's API keys under /who/me/api-keys: GET lists them, by name, lastUsedAt null for a key that never signed in; POST with {name, lifetime, scopes} makes one (lifetime an ISO-8601 duration) and answers 201 with the raw key; POST /{id}/rotations with {overlap} (an ISO-8601 duration) replaces one, as ApiKeyService.rotate(UUID, Duration) does, and answers 201 in the same shape; DELETE /{id} revokes one, 204; GET /current answers the key that signed this request in, in the list's shape.
    ApiKeyService
    Makes, lists, rotates and revokes API keys.
    ApiKeyView
    An API key as GET /who/me/api-keys and GET /who/me/api-keys/current show it: no secret in it.
    CreatedApiKey
    An API key just made or rotated: the only answer that holds the raw key.
    InvalidApiKeyRequestException
    A request to make or rotate an API key that who refuses as it stands: a body that is not the expected JSON, a lifetime or overlap that is not an ISO-8601 duration or is out of range, a blank name, or a scope the owner does not hold.
    JdbcApiKeyCredentialRepository
    JDBC implementation of ApiKeyCredentialRepository backed by the who_api_key_credential table.
    NewApiKey
    A key just made, by ApiKeyService.create(Identity, String, Duration, Set) or ApiKeyService.rotate(UUID, Duration): the only time the raw key exists outside the caller.
    WhoApiKeySecurity
    Adds the API key filter to a Spring Security chain.
    WhoApiKeySecurity.ApiKeyConfigurer
    Configurer that places the API key filter in an HttpSecurity chain.
